From Bastet · Price: the target must touch your trap first.

Theme Force and Energy

  • 1: 10 minutes: plant a magnet trap, or 1 action: magnetize a creature your stand hits; metal objects nearby slam into it: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[bludgeoning]] (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}). A magnetized creature (on a failure) has metal objects stick to it for 1 minute: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 1} if it wears metal or carries metal weapons, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 2} on a critical failure.
  • 5: Magnetism grows: a magnetized creature's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy} rises to 2 after 3 rounds. Surge: pull every unattended metal object within 30 ft onto a creature: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[bludgeoning]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}); it's magnetized on a failure.
  • 9: Two magnetized creatures within 30 ft of each other are pulled together. At the start of each of their turns, each attempts @Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} or is pulled 10 ft toward the other; both take @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[bludgeoning]] if they collide.
  • 13: Magnetize up to 3 creatures your stand hits with one action.
  • 17: A magnetized creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} against metal surfaces.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
